I’m Sayyed Adnan Ali, a Dubai-based marketing and creative professional working across graphic design, animation, video, and brand communications. My background connects marketing strategy with hands-on creative production, from campaign concepts and social content to 2D/3D animation and final delivery. I also design UI/UX experiences and build websites using AI-assisted development workflows.
I start with the audience and the idea. Then I bring strategy, design, and storytelling together to make content and digital experiences that communicate clearly and feel considered.
